references.text: Here the miracle is described where Jesus feeds five thousand men, plus women and children, with five loaves of bread and two fish, and they gather twelve baskets of leftover pieces.
This is another account of how Jesus feeds five thousand men with five loaves of bread and two fish, and they gather twelve baskets of leftovers.
Luke's version of the event where Jesus feeds five thousand men with five loaves of bread, and they gather twelve baskets of leftovers.
John's account of the miracle where Jesus feeds five thousand men with five barley loaves and two small fish, and they gather twelve baskets of leftover pieces.
